{{Quote|Is that the ''Rainbow''?''"<br />"''Nope, looks like a Mark II Imperial Star Destroyer.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Keevy Spart]]|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Invidious''''' was an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]. At the time of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], it was part of a task force commanded by [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc]], and served as part of his fleet when he became a self-proclaimed warlord.

At some point before [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the ''Invidious'' was captured by ex-[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Leonia Tavira]] and became the headquarters of her [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group, the [[Invids]] (which drew their name from the ship).

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used a powerful [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to frighten Tavira into believing that a large [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet, including the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and the [[Sun Crusher]], was arriving in the vicinity, and she fled.
